did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A new person made an account, filled the business application (name, shop, medicine, phone, licence number, address) and attached a licence picture. The owner opened the application, opened and read the licence, and opened a shop account. The applicant came back to the site.

checks.text: The licence file is sent with the application and is kept private: the owner can open it, but the applicant opening the same staff address is sent quietly to the home page
Every look at the licence is logged: two looks were recorded as "application.licence_viewed" at the times the owner opened it
After approval the applicant sees "Your business account is open. Welcome, Meherun Pharmacy."

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The licence picture was made in the page (a sample card) because the pane cannot open a system file dialog. The test account is a throwaway one on the QA copy.

shots.caption: The applicant sent the form with a licence: "We are checking your application"
The owner's Applications page: details, "Open licence", open-as and tier choices
The owner opened the licence file and read it
"Account opened": the application moves to Recently decided
The applicant now lands on the shop order screen: "Your business account is open"
